## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? A clear description of what the pain point is.
*Example: "I am always frustrated when trying to compare Midjourney prompt variations because..."*

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.
*Describe the feature, user interaction, inputs, and expected output.*

## Expected User Benefit
How does this advance SUTRA.ai's local-first, explainable prompt engineering mission? Which user personas benefit most?

## Target Module Affected
- [ ] MOD-01: Home / Dashboard
- [ ] MOD-02: SUTRA Architect
- [ ] MOD-03: SUTRA Optimizer
- [ ] MOD-04: SUTRA Analyzer
- [ ] MOD-05: SUTRA Playground
- [ ] MOD-06: SUTRA Library
- [ ] MOD-07: SUTRA Context Studio
- [ ] MOD-08: SUTRA Workflow Studio
- [ ] MOD-09: SUTRA Academy
- [ ] MOD-10: Settings & Providers

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, third-party tools, or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or relevant research papers here.
